basic_info.description: Welcome to Residence 1601, where the Bay Bridge is yours! This highly coveted one-bedroom plus den, 01-stack home at the bar-setting One Rincon Hill proudly displays immersive & unobstructed Bay Bridge views from all rooms through floor-to-ceiling windows. The kitchen features Italian cabinetry & a professional-grade Bosch stainless steel appliance suite. One Rincon Hill is a world-class building w/ a proven track record of spoiling residents with w/ 5-star hotel-quality amenities, including 24/7 valet full-sized EV parking, a grand porte-cochere, 24/7 concierge, package & dry cleaning attendants, a heated lap pool, hot tub, 2 club-level gyms w/ steam locker rooms, zoom-friendly lounges, secured designated storage, a doggy relief area, & access to the 49th floor Uncle Harry's Resident Lounge. One car valet parking and an additional storage cage complete this home. Love where you live!
